mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.conversation_session_snapshots ( session_id, user_id, messages, token_count, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{messages, typeHandler=com.stockwise.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{tokenCount}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, messages = EXCLUDED.messages, token_count = EXCLUDED.token_count, updated_at = NOW()
